scope.head: c8eb8a2788471638de708cebe72232c7ac75b0ae
scope.range: Current Stage C finite RunSlice/native Pi entry and exact current product proof relative to accepted Stage B c8eb8a2

positive_observations: C-01 and C-02 are directly represented by exact packet admission, disjoint worktree validation, qualification gates, concurrent launch, bounded cancellation, immutable run identity, and no-relaunch reconciliation tests.

C-03 is consistent with the native W1/W2 implementation and focused lifecycle tests: W1 remains in the tool turn, W2 records uncertainty before send, requires native delivery and explicit consumption, deduplicates, and fails closed on session death.
The retained native qualification records actual Pi permission and effect observations, including successful in-root write/read and denied outside-root, shell, and network attempts.

The current canonical product observation records two independently completed matched trials with overlapping factory workers, current integrated acceptance, fresh independent Task QA, aggregate review, Test, and archived Deliver evidence. It reports factory slowdown and higher estimated cost without claiming D-stage repeated benefits.
Current verification records the release suite, optional targeted checks, package, Skill validation, diff check, and zero audit vulnerabilities.
limitations: This review used retained source, narrow-test, native-qualification, product-trial, and release evidence; it did not run providers or execute live experiments.
